name: April no Shinjitsu
source:
It's April 1st, the start of the new school year.
There aren't any classes yet, so I'm just hanging out with my twin like we always do.
He seems a little weird, though...
And I'm...

新学年从4月1日开始。
还没开课，我就像往常一样和我的双胞胎兄弟一起消磨时间。
不过他看起来有点奇怪……
而我……
